==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. I continued my interrogation of the Death Witch in the dungeon. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (The Death Witch was still chained to the dungeon wall, just like last night.) (The Death Witch resembles a woman with pale skin, straight black hair, red eyes, long tattered black robes, and a belt made of skulls.) She wanted to work with me when I first met her, because I am the only human man she's ever met. (There do seem to be very few humans in this world. The only ones I can think of are myself, the Death Witch, and the leader of the Alligator Men. The leader of the Alligator Men resembles a woman with light brown skin, a curly orange afro, and a long yellow dress. Out of the three of us, I am the only man.) She wanted to take over the Elven Village, because she believes humans should rule the world.
